purpose: Resolve the apparent capability layout discrepancy with a coherent original-image OMCI ioctl/platform/DAL chain.
findings: The original image and live-files OMCI kernel modules are different builds. Same-image pf_rt_GetDevCapabilities has a128-byte capability layout, while the live-files build has a larger layout with3-byte per-port entries. Comparing the latter with the older user library produces a false layout discrepancy.
Same-image OMCI_Init calls omci_wrapper_getDevCapabilities for128 bytes. Original omcidrv_ioctl forwards the capability pointer to pf_GetDevCapabilities, without an invented field conversion.
Original platform_db_init populates capacity cache from rt_gpon_scheInfo_get; pf_rt_GetDevCapabilities reads those cache fields. Same-image actual DAL getter returns the four32-bit words31,8,248,248.
Native31 business T-CONTs and248 GEM entries match the proven stock schedule capacity. No evidence warrants reducing or increasing these capacities.

The priority-queue number advertised by ONU2-G can pass through feature hooks and MIB construction. The native280 total queue count is not declared equivalent to the stock248 schedule queue word by this audit.

The separately replayed live-files DAL getter returns the same31,8,248,248 values. Version coherence corrects the capability-structure interpretation without changing the proven lower schedule capacity.

verification.command: Execute original dal_rt_rtl8277c_gpon_scheInfo_get via ModuleOracle with gpon_init1, compare four returned32-bit words with31,8,248,248
verification.result: All four original words observed as expected; no child callbacks or simulated MMIO required.
verification.tests: Two actual DAL getter replays only; no suite or firmware build.

limits: Static original initialization and one actual getter replay do not establish live stock feature hook values or a live MIB upload.
An initial REA open failed before the extracted DAL input existed; the terminal failure is archived. After extraction a separate ready plan succeeded.
No proof of the reported business-mapping -110 location or approximately50-second reset cause.
queue_review: REA original omci_wrapper_setPriQueue and comparator inspected. Comparator places WRR before SP, sorts SP priority descending and uses ME index for equal SP priorities, consistent with the native ordering. This is not a complete queue mutation equivalence proof.
